toc:
  h1 #alerts Alerts
  h2 #что-alert-ом-не-становится Что alert-ом не становится
  h2 #что-alert-ом-становится Что alert-ом становится
---
<h1 id="alerts" data-source-start="1" data-source-end="1">Alerts</h1>
<div class="alert alert-note" data-source-start="3" data-source-end="4">
<p class="alert-title">Note</p>
<p data-source-start="4" data-source-end="4">Useful information that users should know, even when skimming.</p>
</div>
<div class="alert alert-tip" data-source-start="6" data-source-end="7">
<p class="alert-title">Tip</p>
<p data-source-start="7" data-source-end="7">Helpful advice for doing things better.</p>
</div>
<div class="alert alert-important" data-source-start="9" data-source-end="10">
<p class="alert-title">Important</p>
<p data-source-start="10" data-source-end="10">Key information users need to know.</p>
</div>
<div class="alert alert-warning" data-source-start="12" data-source-end="13">
<p class="alert-title">Warning</p>
<p data-source-start="13" data-source-end="13">Urgent info that needs immediate attention.</p>
</div>
<div class="alert alert-caution" data-source-start="15" data-source-end="16">
<p class="alert-title">Caution</p>
<p data-source-start="16" data-source-end="16">Advises about risks or negative outcomes.</p>
</div>
<h2 id="что-alert-ом-не-становится" data-source-start="18" data-source-end="18">Что alert-ом не становится</h2>
<p data-source-start="20" data-source-end="20">Текст на строке маркера убивает alert целиком:</p>
<blockquote data-source-start="22" data-source-end="23">
<p data-source-start="22" data-source-end="23">[!NOTE] с текстом на той же строке
тело</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-source-start="25" data-source-end="25">Маркер не на первой строке:</p>
<blockquote data-source-start="27" data-source-end="28">
<p data-source-start="27" data-source-end="28">сначала текст
[!NOTE]</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-source-start="30" data-source-end="30">Неизвестный маркер:</p>
<blockquote data-source-start="32" data-source-end="33">
<p data-source-start="32" data-source-end="33">[!FOO]
неизвестный маркер</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-source-start="35" data-source-end="35">Маркер без тела:</p>
<blockquote data-source-start="37" data-source-end="37">
<p data-source-start="37" data-source-end="37">[!WARNING]</p>
</blockquote>
<p data-source-start="39" data-source-end="39">Вложенная цитата не alert, GitHub их не вкладывает:</p>
<blockquote data-source-start="41" data-source-end="42">
<blockquote data-source-start="41" data-source-end="42">
<p data-source-start="41" data-source-end="42">[!NOTE]
вложенный</p>
</blockquote>
</blockquote>
<p data-source-start="44" data-source-end="44">Цитата внутри элемента списка тоже:</p>
<ul data-source-start="46" data-source-end="47">
<li data-source-start="46" data-source-end="47">
<blockquote data-source-start="46" data-source-end="47">
<p data-source-start="46" data-source-end="47">[!IMPORTANT]
внутри списка</p>
</blockquote>
</li>
</ul>
<h2 id="что-alert-ом-становится" data-source-start="49" data-source-end="49">Что alert-ом становится</h2>
<p data-source-start="51" data-source-end="51">Маркер в нижнем регистре и без пробела после <code>&gt;</code>:</p>
<div class="alert alert-tip" data-source-start="53" data-source-end="54">
<p class="alert-title">Tip</p>
<p data-source-start="54" data-source-end="54">нижний регистр</p>
</div>
<p data-source-start="56" data-source-end="56">Пробелы в конце строки маркера:</p>
<div class="alert alert-note" data-source-start="58" data-source-end="59">
<p class="alert-title">Note</p>
<p data-source-start="59" data-source-end="59">хвостовые пробелы</p>
</div>
<p data-source-start="61" data-source-end="61">Ленивое продолжение:</p>
<div class="alert alert-caution" data-source-start="63" data-source-end="65">
<p class="alert-title">Caution</p>
<p data-source-start="64" data-source-end="65">первая строка
вторая строка</p>
</div>
<p data-source-start="67" data-source-end="67">Несколько блоков в теле, включая настоящую цитату:</p>
<div class="alert alert-note" data-source-start="69" data-source-end="76">
<p class="alert-title">Note</p>
<p data-source-start="71" data-source-end="71">Первый абзац с <code>кодом</code> и <a href="/doc/docs/other.md">ссылкой</a>.</p>
<ul data-source-start="73" data-source-end="74">
<li data-source-start="73" data-source-end="73">список</li>
<li data-source-start="74" data-source-end="74">внутри</li>
</ul>
<blockquote data-source-start="76" data-source-end="76">
<p data-source-start="76" data-source-end="76">обычная вложенная цитата</p>
</blockquote>
</div>
